independent_review.scope: Prospective diagnostic caller source and original CLI/schema consistency only.

checks: The separate reviewed measurement Context and original Run.command retain real before/common/B18 admission, separate selected-final binding, role-specific artifact maps, exclusive reservation and finite-owner retirement.

Inspect uses the original isolated package-only AOT preparation and exact six positional arguments. Its snake_case receipt fields match the original source, including exact warmup/batch/call counts, actual native hash, executable self-check and zero timing credit.

Shared Page and Retirement use existing actual role manifests. Page executable and PascalCase result fields match. Retirement uses the actual NativeWeave.Data.NativeHost.Tests assembly, and its original hooks enforce complete retirement without assuming four operations per call or an unavailable Pending count.

Shared native mappings are checked against that exact role artifact map and selected database provider. Page additionally checks its executable and build manifest hashes; Retirement executable identity is bound by its producer and owned command, not claimed as a self-reported result field.

The PostgreSQL adapter runs the original loopback private-cluster context, with observed 18.0|on|on|on before the probe and successful original pg_ctl shutdown afterward. The finite owner spans startup before yield, probe, teardown and failures.

The original PostgreSQL application profiler CLI and schemas match. Logging/wait observer and durable result are required. Its automatic GC/default sampling and inherited CPUs2,3 are retained; it is not sent through the different formal database gate.

All six protocol diagnostic profile hashes match and formal_timing_eligible remains false. The original reader must report exactly its profiling-only exclusion; any additional validity, correctness, identity, service or retirement issue fails this caller.
Output directories are fresh, separate from formal output and never resumed. All terminal paths keep duration_credit_seconds zero; no profile marker is removed.
limits: No probe, preparer, target or measurement module was imported or executed during this independent review; no build, test, service or load ran.
This is a new diagnostic caller around surviving original public probes; it is not a recovery of the lost historical private wrapper or its numbers.
Inspect is metadata lookup, not codec computation. Shared Page validation is included in its timings and does not supply an external durable oracle.
Retirement hook storage/work is part of the diagnostic; pending-retirement counts and exact context-switch or wakeup attribution remain unavailable.
PostgreSQL wait occupancy is sampled. Parse/bind/execute counts are not business operations and concurrent statement durations cannot be subtracted from application elapsed time.
Protocol CPU/RSS/approximate GC allocation are whole-process observations, not per-message allocation stacks. gRPC compression remains identity only.
Inspect and Shared do not provide an RSS or post-idle series. No missing metric is inferred.
Actual populated descriptors, source/build/native hashes, completed owner receipts and per-profile results must still be reviewed after execution.
